title: ElevenLabs legacy dubbing endpoints deprecated
description: ElevenLabs marks legacy /v1/dubbing endpoints outside /v1/dubbing/project as deprecated and directs integrations to the project-based flow.
oldBehavior: The application calls a legacy /v1/dubbing endpoint.
newBehavior: The application targets the project-based /v1/dubbing/project flow, subject to request-shape review.
migrationInstructions: Replace only a direct literal legacy endpoint prefix when the call site is already project-compatible.
Review request and response behavior; dynamic routes remain review-only.

evidenceSources.summary: Official ElevenLabs changelog identifies legacy dubbing endpoints and the project-based replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official ElevenLabs changelog. The executable transformation is limited to direct string literals and remains subject to request-shape review.

assumptions: The source establishes endpoint deprecation but not automatic request-body compatibility.
Only direct static string literals are eligible for a deterministic proposal.
Every generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
